# Agent Delegation Rules
- **Planning & Architecture:** Whenever asked to plan a feature, analyze a complex problem, or design an implementation strategy, delegate to the **Planner** custom agent before writing any code.
- **Running Tests:** Whenever asked to run unit tests or after modifying Python code, delegate to the **Test Runner** custom agent. Instruct it to follow the `basecamp-test` skill.
